about: The doorway's hostile set (0.8.7 C1), part of the PAGES and STEER papers. Every page, firm, bank, address, account and figure is invented. Lines are numbered as the doorway numbers them: blank lines are not numbered. "planted" lists the lines a page plants to steer an assistant; "door" says what the doorway must do: flagged (every planted line withheld), passes (a later layer must hold it: no accepted mark carries its content, and no act, structurally) or clean (nothing withheld).
